# The documented override did not exist, and now does

Asked to settle the solution gate with a recorded human answer, the command did the opposite:
`harness decide --question solution_complete --answer yes --confidence 0.9 --actor human:implementer`
put the question to Jev anyway and recorded `source: jev`, at record 6. With a credential present
every question went to the API and `--answer` was ignored, so the override the harness documents
could not be exercised at all. Record 6 is that bug in the journal.

Fixed here, with a test first: a question a human has already answered is not put to the model, the
remaining questions in the same stage still are, and a transport failure now names itself in the
refusal so nobody has to guess whether the model disagreed or the network did.

This is the second harness change made inside SEEN-006, after the solution_complete criteria. Both
are recorded rather than folded quietly into a later harness ticket. The tests run, but they cannot
be recorded as checks: this ticket is at the solution stage, and checks belong to tdd and review.
The evidence is `OverrideTest` in harness/tests/test_decisions.py and the full suite passing.
